story_type: bunker-busting bomb test, fireball out of a tunnel, high-speed impact cameras
hook: The bomb hit above the tunnel. Fire blew out the entrance.
narration: That fireball came out of a tunnel, after a bomb hit the ground above it.
This was an Air Force test of the GBU-57, the Massive Ordnance Penetrator, built to defeat deeply buried and hardened targets.
A penetrator is mostly thick hardened steel. It holds its shape as it drives through rock, and the fuse waits until it is deep inside.
[short pause] High speed cameras caught one driving nose first into the ground before it exploded.
Inside a target tunnel, the nose punched straight down through the ceiling.
outcome: The test showed it could severely damage or destroy targets in reinforced underground facilities.

location_card.place: Air Force and DTRA test, United States

title: Bunker buster blasts out of a tunnel
description:
On Dec. 11, 2020, the Air Force and the Defense Threat Reduction Agency tested the GBU-57 Massive Ordnance Penetrator, a precision-guided bunker-busting munition built to defeat deeply buried and hardened targets.
